newsitem.title: USA: Wallace Computer Services wins supply pact.
newsitem.headline: Wallace Computer Services wins supply pact.

text.p: Wallace Computer Services Inc said Tuesday it had won a five-year contract to supply information management products to the 1,500-member Purchase Connection group purchasing organization in California.
The products include forms, forms management, software and office supplies, Wallace said.
A Wallace spokesman said the contract, which will be shared with another office products supply firm, could be worth about $10 million to Wallace annually.
Wallace provides forms and other information management products. Its shares were up 1/4 at 34-1/8.
